Messages.Author: Mark Lamutt
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with Shackles only has one blood, does he go to torpor when
the Shackles forces him to burn two blood?

I'm sure this one will come up in our game on Friday...

Thanks,
Mark

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <MPG.10c5f9473...@news-2.csn.net>, Mark Lamutt
<mdla...@wcc.com> writes

>If a vampire with Shackles only has one blood, does he go to torpor when
>the Shackles forces him to burn two blood?
>

Burning blood is not damage. If you don't have enough blood to burn
against an effect like that, you just burn all the blood you have.

You don't go to torpor because it's not damage, unless card text says
otherwise.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mdla...@wcc.com (Mark Lamutt) wrote:
> If a vampire with Shackles only has one blood, does he go to torpor when
> the Shackles forces him to burn two blood?

No. Vampires ignore "burn blood" effects once they are empty.
"Burn blood" is not damaging, so can never send a vampire to torpor.

--
